newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-COVENTRY STRIKER NDLOVU SIDELINED FOR SIX WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COVENTRY STRIKER NDLOVU SIDELINED FOR SIX WEEKS.

text.p: Struggling English premier league side Coventry will be without injured Zimbabwe striker Peter Ndlovu for six weeks.
Coventry manager George Strachan said on Tuesday Ndlovu, who has managed only three starts this season, would undergo a cartilage operation later this week.
"The injury has been hanging about which has been a problem for both him and us...it's a real a blow because Peter is a talented lad, " Strachan said.
